title: Bespoke Solvers for Generative Flow Models
tldr_zh: 对预训练流模型学 scale-time 变换+RK 的定制求解器（约 80 参数、约 1% 训练算力），CIFAR-10 10 NFE FID 2.73，ImageNet-64 20 NFE 距 GT 2%
tldr_en: Learns a tiny scale-time-transformed RK solver per pretrained flow (about 80 params, about 1% train compute): CIFAR-10 FID 2.73 at 10 NFE, ImageNet-64 within 2% of GT at 20 NFE.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 FM-OT RK2-Bespoke: FID 3.13/2.73/2.60/2.59 at 8/10/16/20 NFE, GT FID 2.57 (Table 3)
CIFAR-10 10 NFE: Bespoke FM-OT 2.73 vs DEIS 4.17, DPM 4.7, GENIE 5.28, DDIM 13.36 (Table 1)
ImageNet-64 FM/v-CS RK2-Bespoke: FID 2.95/2.20/1.79/1.71/1.69 at 8/10/16/20/24 NFE, GT 1.68 at 176 NFE (Table 2)
ImageNet-128 FM-OT RK2-Bespoke: FID 5.28/3.58/2.64/2.45/2.31 at 8-24 NFE, GT 2.30 at 230 NFE (Table 2)
EDM released CIFAR-10 model: EDM sampler FID 3.05 at 35 NFE vs RK2-Bespoke 2.99 at 20 NFE, 42% fewer NFE (Fig. 4)
Bespoke training costs 0.5-3.6% of original model GPU time; RK2-Bespoke has 8n-1 parameters (Tables 2-3, Sec. 2.2)
